journal_lines: Twisted trunks in the savanna heat.
Dead acacia still standing. Bark stripped clean by antlers.
The roots tore the ground when it went over.
The acacia grain runs at angles. Hard to split clean.
Heat haze over the flat ground. The trees far apart.
The bark is rough and plated. The wood inside is different.
Found a grove of acacia on the hillside. Better growth there.
The fire-blackened trunk was sound below. Took the good sections.
Dry wind all day. The sawdust gone before it settled.
The acacia roots are shallow but wide. Everything trips over them.
Twisted grain on this tree. Beautiful wood to look at. Miserable to cut.
Buzzards watching from the dead branches. Continued anyway.
The flat-topped canopy scattered the light in all directions.
A pride of cats found the sawdust pile. Removed the pile eventually.
A termite mound the size of a boulder nearby. Left that stand alone.
